title: Improve rope hanging and swinging in the Gallery
requires: One working native Gallery target with its shared Slang driver and access to public state/trajectory capture; additional physical devices are not prerequisites for this development task
scope: Post-F8-exit scene-quality follow-up: deferred until F8-99 completes, then reactivate through planning. Follow docs/roadmap/PHYSICS-QUALITY-DEVELOPMENT.md. Reproduce and fix one concrete visible defect in a pinned hanging or swinging rope that exposes stretch, artificial stiffness, jitter, or implausible damping. Keep the scope to this first representative improvement, not a complete family rewrite or all interactions. Improve shared physics within the unchanged one-step, one-spatial-update and solver-work limits. Use existing supported material/interaction semantics; do not add a second production path or platform physics. Independent tasks may merge without waiting for the other five families, a frozen candidate, or whole-project performance/device qualification.
acceptance: Name the observed defect and intended physical response before changing the solver. Retain a reproducible small scene, source/backend/device, scale, material parameters, initial state, camera and public-state evidence for a pinned hanging or swinging rope that exposes stretch, artificial stiffness, jitter, or implausible damping.

Retain comparable before/after Gallery motion as a short clip or ordered frame sequence, plus state/trajectory data. Explain the visible improvement and remaining defects. Rendering, camera, workload reduction or increased damping alone must not conceal an unresolved physics defect.

Use independent physical checks for length/segment strain, endpoint constraints, sag and oscillation/energy with gravity and damping accounted for. Justify any changed expected trajectory with those checks; preserve earlier evidence instead of replacing goldens merely to make tests pass.

Keep exactly one 1/60-second advance, one dynamic spatial update and every existing solver-work budget. Pass affected solver, lifecycle and interaction regressions and required portable/build CI. If the behavior cannot be achieved within the limits, record the gap rather than claim completion or raise a budget.

Deploy the tested change to the working development Gallery target and verify installed revision/backend. Record performance when available, including stalls; explicitly identify unavailable measurements and untested platforms. Aggregate p95 or another family/device does not gate this scoped development merge.

Publish reviewable before/after evidence, numerical results and remaining limitations. Completion means the named first behavior improved; it is not whole-family, all-platform, or final 60 Hz qualification.
